summary: Tested the new features end to end. Backend: 20 of 21 pytest tests pass. The new file test_places_payment.py covers Amil/Green Park orders with complement, change_for persistence, and PATCH /api/orders/{id}/payment: it saves, a GET confirms it, it returns 404 for an unknown id and 422 when payment_method is missing. The one failure: the endpoint accepts any payment_method, e.g. 'Bitcoin'. Frontend: checkout step 1 works. The place buttons show the right labels (Setor/Intervalo disponível for Amil, Bloco/Apartamento for Green Park). Continuar stays disabled until name, phone, place and both details are filled, and whitespace-only details don't count. Switching place clears the details. The calendar is in pt-BR. All 5 payment options are shown. Dinheiro shows the change box and switch. A change amount below the total (50 < 65,80) shows the error toast and blocks submit. '100,00' is accepted and saved as change_for=100. The WhatsApp link goes to wa.me/5541989023769 and includes 'Local de entrega: Green Park - Bloco: Bloco 4 · Apartamento: 302' and 'Dinheiro (troco para R$ 100,00)'. Admin: the order card shows the place and details. The payment editor (select, change input only for Dinheiro, save) works, and the change survives a page reload. In Relatórios the totals and the per-payment and per-day tables are correct. The from/to date filter works. The per-payment table updates after a payment edit. Regression: setting 'Entregue - Aguardando Pagamento' opens wa.me/55<customer phone> with the charge message. Settings are intact.

minor.issue: No validation of payment_method. Any string (e.g. 'Bitcoin') is accepted and then shows up as its own row in Relatórios. change_for is not checked against the total, and it is not forced to null for methods other than Dinheiro.

address/complement are not checked against Amil/Green Park, and change_for is not checked (it can be lower than the total, or sent with a non-cash method). The client-side price trust from iteration_2 is still there.
Still no server-side admin auth (carried over from iteration_2). PATCH payment and GET orders are public.

ui_bugs.issue: The from/to date filter resets when switching tabs, because the component unmounts.

issues: The date filters use native <input type=date>, shown as mm/dd/yyyy (US format) in a Portuguese app. Use a shadcn Calendar/Popover with ptBR.
Totals include every order whatever its status. Consider separating paid from pending ('Pago' vs 'A pagar').
The charge message for Dinheiro orders doesn't mention the change amount (troco). This would be helpful for the delivery person.

action_items: Validate payment_method in PaymentUpdate/OrderInput against the allowed list (Pix, Cartão de Crédito, Cartão de Débito, Pluxee Refeição, Dinheiro). Set change_for to null unless the method is Dinheiro. Optionally require change_for >= total.
OrderPaymentEditor: validate that the change amount is >= the order total, as checkout does
(Optional) Replace the native date inputs in Relatórios with shadcn Calendar (ptBR); keep the filter state when switching tabs
critical_code_review_comments: OrderPaymentEditor initializes method/change from props only once. After Cancel, reopening shows the previously chosen but unsaved value. Reset the state on cancel.
Admin.jsx is 640 lines; consider splitting it into tab components
delivery_date still uses date.toISOString(), which shifts by a day in UTC+ timezones. Use date-fns format(date,'yyyy-MM-dd') instead.
Reports are computed on the client from GET /api/orders (the limit is 1000). This won't scale; consider a backend aggregation endpoint.

success_rate.backend: 95% (20/21; the failure is missing payment_method validation)

seed_data_creation: Deleted all TEST_* orders (18) from Mongo directly. 1 non-test order remains. Settings were verified unchanged: store_whatsapp=5541989023769, pix_key=''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests. Product slug ids such as cuca-de-banana-com-farofa-doce; flavor option snack-flavor-option-<id>-banana. Calendar days are found with button[name='day']:not([disabled]) inside checkout-delivery-date-calendar. Select options in admin are found with get_by_role('option', name=..., exact=True). Capture window.open with page.add_script_tag after login. There is no order delete endpoint; clean up TEST_ orders via Mongo.
